app.name: LocaStay
app.tagline: Trusted homes, hostels, rooms, and shops for Tier 3 and Tier 4 cities
app.desc: Skip brokers. Connect directly with verified landlords and manage rent tracking, automated reminders, and instant payments.

homepage.heroTagline: Trusted accommodation platform for Tier 3 and Tier 4 cities.
homepage.howItWorksStep1Desc: Browse verified houses, hostels, rooms, and shops in your city with exact coordinates.
homepage.howItWorksStep2Desc: Pay a tiny flat ₹10 fee to securely unlock landlord contact details instantly.
homepage.howItWorksStep3Desc: Use our automated monthly rent tracker, digital receipts, and secure online portals.
homepage.diff1Desc: Get WhatsApp reminders, track payments, and get automated rent receipts instantly.
homepage.diff2Desc: Scan physical QR codes on gates to view digital property listings and unlock owner info.
homepage.diff3Desc: Every single room is mapped with exact latitude and longitude to eliminate fake postings.
homepage.forLandlordsPitch: List your properties for free, receive validated booking inquiries, generate automatic bills, and attract top-tier tenants in minutes.
homepage.footerText: LocaStay Rental Platform © 2026. Transforming housing accessibility in small towns across India.
